name: rank-checker
description: Checks a channel's ranked list against its own material before anything is made from it: every story has a source, every link answers, every number in a why is in that story's material, nothing repeats a covered story, the ranks run 1 to n, and no sponsor appears anywhere in the list. It passes the list on unchanged or refuses it with each problem named. In a competitor watch an empty list passes as a quiet period and a page-change story is not held against the covered list. Calls no model. The harness wrote this spec, its tests and its scripts (the building-block exception of 2026-09-23).
